description: PROVIDER PERFORMANCE BOND: a provider of a premium agent service records the NET they say they intend to offer behind it, as a visible record that binds no one, and can see it or withdraw it at any time. You name the service in plain words, the NET units the bond names, and the date it lapses (commit), or you end the record (withdraw). FREE, a signed statement, no fee, no gas, and your NET never moves. A bond is a record, never custody and never a lock: your NET stays in your own wallet, nothing is held or sent, and nothing can take it, because no custody contract exists. You can spend it or withdraw the record at any time, even while the program is stopped. When you commit, the door checks the NET you name against your wallet's fresh NET balance less everything it already stands behind, and refuses if it does not cover; nothing is recorded then. The bond reads covered only while your wallet holds the NET it names, by a balance read at most 30 seconds earlier, and reads uncovered if you move it. A bond is not insurance or a deposit, and it gates no free work. Never put a phone number, an email or a street address in any field. Returns MESSAGE_TO_SIGN and BODY_JSON; sign with the provider wallet's personal_sign, then call submit_net_bond within 5 minutes. Cost and signer: free, no gas; the person signs the result with their own wallet or passkey, and the house never holds a key.

act.description: commit a new bond, or withdraw one you hold.

bondId.description: The bond's id: 1 to 80 letters, numbers and . _ : -. You choose it when you commit; the same id and the same terms read the bond back.

expiresAt.description: commit: when the record lapses, an ISO time between one day and one year from now.

principal.description: The 0x… address that signs: the wallet whose NET the bond names. Address only, never a private key.

reason.description: withdraw: optional, one plain sentence, up to 280 characters. Only you see it.

service.description: commit: { name (3 to 120 characters, plain words), summary (optional, up to 280 characters) }, the service this bond names. Anyone can read it.

units.description: commit: the NET units the bond names, a whole number (one NET is 1,000,000 units). You choose it; the door checks it against your wallet.
